none: PAS SOM-716474: SOM-716474: Roman T-shaped, enamelled brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Dorset (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Roman T-shaped, enamelled brooch. The head of the brooch is wide, thin and circular in section. A hole through the centre of this still holds the axis bar. In the middle, to the rear of the head is a slot to allow a pin with a hinge to sit in place, secured by this axis bar. The pin is now missing. The bow and leg are semi-circular in profile. The bow is highly curved. Below the head…
